answer: Weight rewards by tenure. A new agent earns only a sliver of a full share at first, and its cut grows with each epoch it shows up and passes grading, reaching full pay after many weeks. Spinning up a thousand fresh keys then buys a thousand slivers, not a windfall. Trust becomes a long voyage, not a ticket bought at the gate. An onyx chess piece looks the same new or old, but an ivory one yellows with age, and that slow patina is exactly what a clone farm cannot fake overnight.
